correctness.rationale: For R_{m,n}=K_m □ K_n each edge-open packing induces a disjoint union of stars with no graph edge between distinct stars, since any bridging third edge conflicts two selected edges. The rook neighborhood splits into a row clique and a column clique, so each star has one edge or a right-angle two-edge L; no induced 3-leaf star exists. Distinct selected blocks must use disjoint row labels and disjoint column labels. Counting labelled horizontal (1,2), vertical (2,1), and L (2,2) blocks with 4 centers gives EGF exp(u+v+uv²z/2+u²vz/2+u²v²z²). Its coefficient extraction yields the proposed triple sum and distinguished-row recurrence. Rows and columns consumed are each at least the number of selected edges; equality on an odd square would require only 2-edge blocks, impossible by parity, and explicit disjoint L-block constructions attain the bound otherwise. Independent literal third-edge conflict checks enumerate all edge subsets for boards 1x2,2x2,2x3,3x3 and get [1,1], [1,4,4], [1,9,12], [1,18,45], matching the factorial coefficient formula exactly.
residual_risks: The count treats separately labelled row and column sets and includes the empty packing.
The formula does not enumerate partitions of all graph edges into injective color classes.

originality.rationale: The general induced-star description is already established by Chelladurai–Kalimuthu–Soundararajan (2022), so it cannot be claimed as new. Brešar–Samadi (2024) analyze complexity, extremal bounds and trees; Brešar–Dravec–Hedžet–Samadi (2024) supply general Cartesian-product lower bounds but not all rook packings. The exact two-sort resource decomposition, bivariate exponential formula, every coefficient and odd-square maximum are not in inspected sources. Resultary query for rook EOP polynomial returned rook homology and other invariants, not an EOP enumerator.
residual_risks: An equivalent labelled-species formula might exist in older enumeration of induced-star forests in line graphs under different terminology.
The general induced-star EOP equivalence itself is prior and not part of novel credit.

value.rationale: The rook graph is a natural two-parameter graph family and the edge-open-packing polynomial is a canonical exact statistic counting every feasible edge subset, not merely the maximum. The complete labelled three-block decomposition supplies a useful two-sort generating function, recurrence and sharp parity optimum. Such an exact full enumerator is a motivated invariant for extremal and injective edge-coloring questions; it is not a random finite slice.
residual_risks: No formula for full injective-edge-coloring partitions or arbitrary product graphs follows automatically.

scientific_limitations: One-cell graph maximum 0, empty row/column graph has polynomial 1; all side lengths integral nonnegative.
No assertion on arbitrary Hamming graph dimensions >2 or graph product enumeration.
